name: publicrecords-mcp
description: Twenty-eight remote MCP servers for publicrecords Apify Actors, including PDF to text, web page to Markdown, audio transcription, email domain/MX/disposable checks (not a mailbox check), website tech-stack detection, phone number validation (not a live carrier lookup), Wikipedia/ECB FX/Treasury lookup, Crossref paper and DOI search, and bulk DNS / SPF / DMARC lookup, jobs, procurement, ads, company socials, sports odds, and Spotify play counts. Each server is hosted at mcp.apify.com. Authenticate with your own Apify account (OAuth or an API token). This plugin does not bundle tokens.
